---

Consider this question: *if a household's income rises, by how much does its consumption rise?*

To answer it, we collect data on many households and draw them in a **scatter plot**. Each point represents one household.

<div class="rv" id="rv-scatter">
<div class="rv-title">Figure 1.1. From a cloud of points to a line</div>
<div class="rv-ctrl"><button class="primary" id="rv-scatter-btn">Show the line that summarises the pattern</button></div>
<svg class="rv-svg" viewBox="0 0 560 320" role="img" aria-label="Scatter plot of income and consumption for 20 households"></svg>
<p class="rv-out"></p>
</div>

**Regression studies how the average value of one variable (Y) changes when another variable (X) changes.** The result is summarised by a line.

| Symbol | Name | In the example |
|:-:|---|---|
| Y | **dependent** variable (explained) | consumption |
| X | **independent** variable (explanatory) | income |

## Three patterns

<div class="rv" id="rv-pattern">
<div class="rv-title">Figure 1.2. Positive, negative, and no relationship</div>
<div class="rv-row">
<figure><svg class="rv-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 170" role="img" aria-label="Positive relationship"></svg><figcaption><b>Positive</b><br>X rises, Y tends to rise</figcaption></figure>
<figure><svg class="rv-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 170" role="img" aria-label="Negative relationship"></svg><figcaption><b>Negative</b><br>X rises, Y tends to fall</figcaption></figure>
<figure><svg class="rv-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 170" role="img" aria-label="No relationship"></svg><figcaption><b>No relationship</b><br>the line is nearly flat</figcaption></figure>
</div>
<p class="rv-out">Examples: income and consumption (positive); price and quantity demanded (negative); shoe size and exam score (no relationship).</p>
</div>

## Association is not causation

Ice-cream sales and drowning cases both rise in summer. They are associated, but ice cream does not cause drowning; both are driven by a third factor, hot weather.

<div class="rv" id="rv-causal">
<div class="rv-title">Figure 1.3. A hidden third factor</div>
<svg class="rv-svg" viewBox="0 0 560 230" role="img" aria-label="Diagram: hot weather affects ice-cream sales and drowning cases">
<defs><marker id="rv-ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" class="rv-head"/></marker></defs>
<rect x="200" y="14" width="160" height="50" rx="8" class="rv-box"/>
<text x="280" y="44" text-anchor="middle" class="rv-t">Hot weather</text>
<rect x="30" y="160" width="170" height="50" rx="8" class="rv-box"/>
<text x="115" y="190" text-anchor="middle" class="rv-t">Ice-cream sales</text>
<rect x="360" y="160" width="170" height="50" rx="8" class="rv-box"/>
<text x="445" y="190" text-anchor="middle" class="rv-t">Drowning cases</text>
<path d="M240 66 L140 156" class="rv-arrow" marker-end="url(#rv-ah)"/>
<path d="M320 66 L420 156" class="rv-arrow" marker-end="url(#rv-ah)"/>
<text x="160" y="106" text-anchor="end" class="rv-ts">affects</text>
<text x="400" y="106" class="rv-ts">affects</text>
<path d="M204 185 L356 185" class="rv-arrow-d"/>
<text x="280" y="176" text-anchor="middle" class="rv-note">associated,</text>
<text x="280" y="204" text-anchor="middle" class="rv-note">not causal</text>
</svg>
<p class="rv-out">Regression shows <b>association</b>. A causal claim needs theory and an appropriate research design.</p>
</div>
